name: i18n-override-registry
title: Single i18n override registry across component packages
description: Replace per-package i18n override injection keys with a single shared override registry keyed by libraryId, provided once by AdminProvider so hosts supply ui + admin (and future package) text overrides through one channel with no UiProvider. Introduce libraryI18nOverridesKey + LibraryI18nOverridesRegistry in packages/i18n; drop overridesKey from LibraryI18nDescriptor; createComponentI18n resolves registry[descriptor.libraryId] ?? descriptor.emptySnapshot; AdminProvider overrides prop becomes the registry (per-entry structuredClone); remove adminI18nOverridesKey/DEFAULT_SNAPSHOT vestiges; update tests + spec.
creator: hechang27-sprt
